title: 第20章
content:
萧家一行人最终还是在楚家下人的引领下，住进了楚家最好的客院。萧云峰那张老脸黑得像锅底，甩袖进入房间时，那“嘭”的一声关门巨响，隔着老远都能听见，显然是气得不轻。他对萧清雪今日的决定极为不满，嘴里嘀咕着“妇人之仁”、“养虎为患”之类的话，但萧清雪只是清冷地瞥了他一眼，便径直走向另一间厢房，连一个多余的字都懒得说。萧清雪在家族中的地位和那恐怖的天赋，即便是长老，也得掂量掂量。楚家大厅的闹剧，如同一阵飓风，迅速席卷了整个青阳城。楚家废物楚皓，当众撕毁婚书，三招两式废掉林家天才林云，更口出狂言，要夺青阳大比魁首！每一条消息都足以让青阳城抖三抖。各方势力都在暗中观察，想看看这楚家，究竟是出了个妖孽，还是回光返照的疯子。楚皓回到自己那间简陋得有些寒酸的小院时，楚山河正等在门口，神色复杂至极。他看着楚皓，张了张嘴，似乎想说什么，最终却只是化作一声长长的叹息，眼神里混杂着惊惧、困惑，还有一丝他自己都未察觉的……希冀？“皓儿，你……”楚山河欲言又止。楚皓连眼皮都没抬一下，径直从他身边走过，推开了自己房间的门。对于这个在他受辱时只会下跪求饶的父亲，他已无话可说。楚山河看着楚皓的背影，嘴唇哆嗦了几下，最后颓然地摆了摆手，佝偻着身子离开了。院子里洒扫的几个下人，远远看见楚皓，连忙低下头，恭敬地躬身行礼，大气都不敢喘一口。那态度，与往日里那种若有若无的轻慢，简直是天壤之别。楚皓甚至看到一个前几日还对他爱答不理的小厮，此刻正努力地挤出一个讨好的笑容，那张脸笑得像一朵盛开的菊花。呵，现实。楚皓反手关上房门，落了栓。外界的纷纷扰扰，此刻都与他无关。他现在最关心的，是脑海中那部名为《吞天魔功》的神级功法！光听名字，就透着一股无法无天的霸道！他盘膝坐在床上，屏息凝神，按照脑海中那玄奥的法诀，尝试运转《吞天魔功》。功法初一运转，楚皓便感觉自己仿佛化作了一个无底的黑洞。一股难以形容的恐怖吸力，猛地从他四肢百骸每一个毛孔中爆发出来！周遭空气中的稀薄元气，如同受到了致命的吸引，疯狂地向他体内涌来。他体内原本那点微不足道，甚至有些驳杂的淬体三重的元力，在这股霸道吸力的拉扯和功法的锤炼下，竟以肉眼可见的速度被压缩、提纯，变得无比凝练精纯。经脉似乎都在微微发胀，有一种酥麻的快感。“爽！”楚皓心中暗赞。但这空气中的元气，对于《吞天魔功》和混沌圣体而言，简直是杯水车薪，塞牙缝都不够。他能感觉到，自己的身体像一个饿了千百年的饕餮巨兽，正发出对能量的强烈渴望。“看来，还是得找点‘补品’才行。”楚皓咂了咂嘴。就在这时，脑海中那熟悉的系统提示音再次响起。【叮！新手期辅助，宿主可感知身边十米内能量最浓郁之物一次。】“哦？还有这好事？”楚皓眼睛一亮，这系统还挺贴心。他立刻集中精神，依照系统的指引，将感知力缓缓散开。房间里的一切，桌椅板凳，被褥茶杯，都清晰地映入脑海。很快，他的注意力便被床头角落里一个不起眼的旧木盒吸引了。那里，正传来一股微弱，却异常精纯的能量波动。“咦？”楚皓有些意外。他伸手将那木盒取了过来。这是一个很普通的楠木盒子，边角已经有些磨损，看起来有些年头了。打开盒盖，里面静静地躺着一枚通体黝黑的玉佩。玉佩的样式古朴简单，没有任何花哨的纹路，表面也并非光滑如镜，反而带着一丝粗糙的质感，扔在大街上估计都没人会多看一眼。这枚玉佩，是原主母亲留下的唯一遗物。原主自小佩戴，后来身体日渐孱弱，才取下珍藏起来，却从未发现它有任何特异之处。楚皓拿起玉佩，入手微凉。他凝视着这枚黑玉佩，心中不由泛起一丝波澜。关于母亲的记忆已经很模糊了，只记得她总是带着温柔的笑容，轻轻抚摸他的头。“娘……”楚皓轻声呢喃，将玉佩紧紧握在掌心。他深吸一口气，再次运转《吞天魔功》。就在功法运转的刹那，掌心中的黑色玉佩突然微微一震，竟散发出一股温热的感觉！紧接着，一股奇异的吸力从玉佩中传出，与《吞天魔功》产生的吸力形成了强烈的共鸣！“嗡——”下一刻，楚皓只觉一股远比他自身元力精纯百倍，甚至千倍的磅礴能量，如同开闸的洪水一般，从黑色玉佩中狂涌而出！这股能量精纯至极，带着一丝古老而温润的气息，被《吞天魔功》疯狂地牵引着，通过他的手臂，涌入四肢百骸，冲刷着他的每一条经脉，每一个细胞！“好强的能量！”楚皓心中大骇，但更多的是狂喜！他体内的混沌圣体似乎也感受到了这股精纯的能量，自行运转起来，贪婪地吸收、炼化着这股突如其来的“大补之物”。那些原本坚固无比的修为瓶颈，在这股能量的冲击下，如同纸糊的一般，开始剧烈松动。

“轰！”楚皓只觉体内传来一声沉闷的巨响，仿佛有什么枷锁被彻底挣断！一股前所未有的强大力量感，充斥全身！淬体境四重！成了！那股舒畅淋漓的感觉，让他忍不住想仰天长啸！然而，这还没完！黑色玉佩中的能量依旧源源不断地涌出，似乎无穷无尽。楚皓不敢怠慢，全力运转《吞天魔功》和混沌圣体，疯狂地吸收炼化。他的气息，在以一种骇人听闻的速度节节攀升！淬体境四重中期！淬体境四重后期！淬体境四重巅峰！“轰！”又是一声闷响！瓶颈再次被摧枯拉朽般冲破！淬体境五重！楚皓浑身骨骼噼啪作响，皮肤表面渗出一层细密的黑色杂质，那是身体经过能量洗礼后排出的污垢。他能清晰地感觉到，自己的肉身强度、元力雄浑程度，都在发生着翻天覆地的变化！能量的灌输仍在继续！淬体境五重初期！淬体境五重中期！淬体境五重后期！直到……淬体境五重巅峰！当楚皓的气息稳稳停在淬体境五重巅峰时，那股从玉佩中涌出的能量才终于缓缓减弱，最终彻底消失。“呼——”楚皓长长地吐出一口浊气，这口浊气带着一丝淡淡的腥甜，仿佛将体内的所有郁结都吐了出去。他缓缓睁开双眼，眸中精光一闪而逝，如同暗夜中的星辰。感受着体内那澎湃汹涌，比之前强大了何止十倍的力量，楚皓嘴角忍不住勾起一抹自信的笑容。淬体境五重巅峰！仅仅片刻功夫，连破两重大境界，还直接冲到了五重巅峰！这《吞天魔功》和混沌圣体，配合这神秘玉佩，简直是逆天！“三个月后，青阳大比魁首？”楚皓握了握拳，感受着指掌间爆炸性的力量，眼中闪烁着强烈的战意，“呵呵，现在看来，似乎也不是什么难事了。”他摊开手掌，那枚黑色玉佩依旧静静地躺在那里，只是表面的光泽变得黯淡了许多，之前那股温热感也消失了，恢复了冰凉的触感，仿佛耗尽了所有能量。但楚皓知道，这枚母亲留下的玉佩，绝非凡物。今日只是初露峥嵘，日后定还有更大的秘密。他小心翼翼地将玉佩重新贴身戴好，感受着那份熟悉的冰凉，心中一片火热。萧清雪，林云，还有那些曾经看不起我楚皓的人，你们给我等着！三十年河西，莫欺少年穷！现在，轮到我楚皓，让你们好好看一看了！

Finally, under the guidance of the servants of the Chu family, the Xiao family moved into the best guest house of the Chu family.Xiao Yunfeng's old face was as dark as the bottom of a pot. When he fluttered his sleeves and entered the room, there was a loud "bang" of the door closing, which could be heard from a distance. He was obviously very angry.He was extremely dissatisfied with Xiao Qingxue's decision today, muttering words such as "women's benevolence" and "raising a tiger is a disaster", but Xiao Qingxue just glanced at him coldly and walked straight to another wing, not even bothering to say a single extra word.Even the elders have to weigh Xiao Qingxue's status in the family and her terrifying talent.The farce in the Chu family hall was like a hurricane, quickly sweeping through the entire Qingyang City.Chu Hao, the good-for-nothing of the Chu family, tore up the marriage contract in public, used three tricks to destroy Lin Yun, the genius of the Lin family, and even uttered wild words that he wanted to win the Qingyang Competition!Every piece of news is enough to make Qingyang City tremble.All forces are secretly observing, wanting to see if this Chu family is a monster or a madman who has returned to his former glory.When Chu Hao returned to his shabby little courtyard, Chu Shanhe was waiting at the door with an extremely complicated expression.He looked at Chu Hao and opened his mouth, as if he wanted to say something, but in the end it just turned into a long sigh. His eyes were mixed with fear, confusion, and a trace of... hope that he himself was not aware of."Hao'er, you..." Chu Shanhe stopped talking.Chu Hao didn't even raise his eyelids, walked straight past him and opened the door to his room.He had nothing to say to this father who would only kneel down and beg for mercy when he was humiliated.Chu Shanhe looked at Chu Hao's back, his lips trembled a few times, and finally waved his hands dejectedly, hunched over and left.When several servants sweeping the yard saw Chu Hao from a distance, they quickly lowered their heads and bowed respectfully, not daring to take a breath.That attitude was completely different from the casual contempt in the past.Chu Hao even saw a boy who had ignored him a few days ago, who was trying hard to smile in a flattering way, with his face smiling like a blooming chrysanthemum.Oh, reality.Chu Hao closed the door with his backhand and locked it.The disturbances from the outside world have nothing to do with him at this moment.What he is most concerned about now is the god-level skill in his mind called "Swallowing the Sky Demon Skill"!Just hearing the name, there is a sense of lawlessness and domineering!He sat cross-legged on the bed, holding his breath and concentrating, trying to operate the "Swallowing Heaven Demon Technique" according to the mysterious magic formula in his mind.As soon as the technique started to work, Chu Hao felt as if he had turned into a bottomless black hole.An indescribable terrifying suction force suddenly erupted from every pore of his limbs!The thin vitality in the air around him surged crazily into his body as if being fatally attracted.The originally negligible and even somewhat mixed body-tempering third-level Yuan Power in his body was compressed and purified at a speed visible to the naked eye under the pull of this overbearing suction force and the tempering of the technique, and became extremely condensed and pure.My meridians seemed to be slightly swollen, giving me a numbing sensation."It's cool!" Chu Hao secretly praised in his heart.But the vitality in the air is simply a drop in the bucket for the "Swallowing Heaven Demon Technique" and the Chaos Holy Body.He could feel that his body was like a gluttonous beast that had been hungry for thousands of years, emitting a strong desire for energy."It seems that we still need to find some 'supplements'." Chu Hao smacked his lips.At this moment, the familiar system prompt in his mind sounded again.【bite!As an assistant in the novice stage, the host can sense the most energetic thing within ten meters around him once.] "Oh? Is there such a good thing?" Chu Hao's eyes lit up, this system is quite considerate.He immediately concentrated and followed the system's guidance to slowly spread his perception.Everything in the room, tables, chairs, benches, bedding and teacups, all came to mind clearly.Soon, his attention was attracted by an inconspicuous old wooden box in the corner of the bed.There, a weak but extremely pure energy wave was coming."Huh?" Chu Hao was a little surprised.He reached out and took out the wooden box.This is a very ordinary nanmu box, with some wear and tear on the corners. It looks like it has been around for a while.Opening the lid of the box, a dark jade pendant lay quietly inside.The style of the jade pendant is simple and simple, without any fancy lines, and the surface is not as smooth as a mirror, but has a rough texture. If you throw it on the street, no one will take a second look.This jade pendant is the only relic left by the original owner's mother.The original owner had worn it since he was a child. Later, when his health became increasingly frail, he took it off and kept it, but he never found anything special about it.Chu Hao picked up the jade pendant, his hands slightly cold.He stared at the black jade pendant, and couldn't help but feel a wave of emotion in his heart.The memory of his mother is very vague. I only remember that she always had a gentle smile and gently stroked his head."Mother..." Chu Hao murmured softly, holding the jade pendant tightly in his palm.He took a deep breath and activated the "Swallowing Heaven Demon Technique" again.At the moment when the technique was running, the black jade pendant in the palm suddenly shook slightly and emitted a warm feeling!Immediately afterwards, a strange suction force came from the jade pendant, which strongly resonated with the suction force generated by the "Swallowing Heaven Demon Technique"!"Buzz--" The next moment, Chu Hao felt a majestic energy that was a hundred times or even a thousand times purer than his own Yuanli, rushing out from the black jade pendant like a flood opening!This energy was extremely pure, with a hint of ancient and gentle aura. It was pulled crazily by the "Swallowing Heaven Demon Technique" and flowed through his arms, into his limbs and bones, scouring every meridian and every cell in his body!"Such a strong energy!" Chu Hao was horrified, but even more ecstatic!The Chaos Holy Body in his body seemed to feel this pure energy, and started to operate on its own, greedily absorbing and refining this sudden "big tonic".Those cultivation bottlenecks that were originally extremely solid began to loosen violently like paper under the impact of this energy.

"Boom!" Chu Hao felt a dull loud sound coming from his body, as if some shackles were completely broken!An unprecedented sense of powerful power fills the whole body!Fourth level of body tempering realm!Done!The refreshing feeling made him want to look up to the sky and scream!However, this is not over yet!The energy in the black jade pendant is still flowing out, seemingly endless.Chu Hao did not dare to neglect, and used the "Swallowing Heaven Demon Technique" and the Chaos Holy Body with all his strength, absorbing and refining crazily.His aura was rising steadily at an appalling speed!The middle stage of the fourth level of the body quenching realm!The late stage of the fourth level of the body quenching realm!The peak of the fourth level of the body tempering realm!"Boom!" There was another muffled sound!The bottleneck was once again broken through like a torrent!Fifth level of body tempering realm!The bones all over Chu Hao's body were crackling, and a layer of fine black impurities exuded from the surface of his skin, which was the dirt discharged from the body after being baptized by energy.He could clearly feel that the strength of his physical body and the vigor of his Yuan Power were undergoing earth-shaking changes!The infusion of energy continues!The early stage of the fifth level of the body quenching realm!The middle stage of the fifth level of the body quenching realm!Late stage of fifth level of body tempering realm!Until...the peak of the fifth level of the Body Tempering Realm!When Chu Hao's aura steadily stopped at the fifth level peak of the Body Tempering Realm, the energy pouring out of the jade pendant finally slowly weakened and finally disappeared completely."Huh..." Chu Hao exhaled a long breath of turbid air, which had a hint of fishy sweetness, as if he had vomited out all the stagnation in his body.He slowly opened his eyes, and the light in his eyes flashed like stars in the dark night.Feeling the surging power in his body, which was more than ten times stronger than before, Chu Hao couldn't help but curl up with a confident smile.The fifth level peak of the body tempering realm!In just a moment, he broke through two major realms in a row and rushed directly to the fifth level peak!This "Swallowing Heaven Demon Technique" and the Chaos Holy Body, combined with this mysterious jade pendant, are simply heaven-defying!"Three months later, the leader of the Qingyang Competition?" Chu Hao clenched his fists, feeling the explosive power between his fingers, and his eyes flashed with a strong fighting spirit. "Haha, it seems that it is not that difficult now." He spread his palms, and the black jade pendant was still lying there quietly, but the luster on the surface became much duller. The previous warm feeling also disappeared, and the cold touch was restored, as if all the energy had been exhausted.But Chu Hao knew that this jade pendant left by his mother was absolutely extraordinary.Today is just the first glimpse, but there will definitely be even greater secrets in the future.He carefully put the jade pendant back on his body, feeling the familiar coldness, and his heart felt hot.Xiao Qingxue, Lin Yun, and those who once looked down on me, Chu Hao, just wait for me!Thirty years in Hexi, don’t bully young people into poverty!Now, it's my turn, Chu Hao, to let you take a good look!

萧家一行人最终还是在楚家下人的引领下，住进了楚家最好的客院。萧云峰那张老脸黑得像锅底，甩袖进入房间时，那“嘭”的一声关门巨响，隔着老远都能听见，显然是气得不轻。他对萧清雪今日的决定极为不满，嘴里嘀咕着“妇人之仁”、“养虎为患”之类的话，但萧清雪只是清冷地瞥了他一眼，便径直走向另一间厢房，连一个多余的字都懒得说。萧清雪在家族中的地位和那恐怖的天赋，即便是长老，也得掂量掂量。楚家大厅的闹剧，如同一阵飓风，迅速席卷了整个青阳城。楚家废物楚皓，当众撕毁婚书，三招两式废掉林家天才林云，更口出狂言，要夺青阳大比魁首！每一条消息都足以让青阳城抖三抖。各方势力都在暗中观察，想看看这楚家，究竟是出了个妖孽，还是回光返照的疯子。楚皓回到自己那间简陋得有些寒酸的小院时，楚山河正等在门口，神色复杂至极。他看着楚皓，张了张嘴，似乎想说什么，最终却只是化作一声长长的叹息，眼神里混杂着惊惧、困惑，还有一丝他自己都未察觉的……希冀？“皓儿，你……”楚山河欲言又止。楚皓连眼皮都没抬一下，径直从他身边走过，推开了自己房间的门。对于这个在他受辱时只会下跪求饶的父亲，他已无话可说。楚山河看着楚皓的背影，嘴唇哆嗦了几下，最后颓然地摆了摆手，佝偻着身子离开了。院子里洒扫的几个下人，远远看见楚皓，连忙低下头，恭敬地躬身行礼，大气都不敢喘一口。那态度，与往日里那种若有若无的轻慢，简直是天壤之别。楚皓甚至看到一个前几日还对他爱答不理的小厮，此刻正努力地挤出一个讨好的笑容，那张脸笑得像一朵盛开的菊花。呵，现实。楚皓反手关上房门，落了栓。外界的纷纷扰扰，此刻都与他无关。他现在最关心的，是脑海中那部名为《吞天魔功》的神级功法！光听名字，就透着一股无法无天的霸道！他盘膝坐在床上，屏息凝神，按照脑海中那玄奥的法诀，尝试运转《吞天魔功》。功法初一运转，楚皓便感觉自己仿佛化作了一个无底的黑洞。一股难以形容的恐怖吸力，猛地从他四肢百骸每一个毛孔中爆发出来！周遭空气中的稀薄元气，如同受到了致命的吸引，疯狂地向他体内涌来。他体内原本那点微不足道，甚至有些驳杂的淬体三重的元力，在这股霸道吸力的拉扯和功法的锤炼下，竟以肉眼可见的速度被压缩、提纯，变得无比凝练精纯。经脉似乎都在微微发胀，有一种酥麻的快感。“爽！”楚皓心中暗赞。但这空气中的元气，对于《吞天魔功》和混沌圣体而言，简直是杯水车薪，塞牙缝都不够。他能感觉到，自己的身体像一个饿了千百年的饕餮巨兽，正发出对能量的强烈渴望。“看来，还是得找点‘补品’才行。”楚皓咂了咂嘴。就在这时，脑海中那熟悉的系统提示音再次响起。【叮！新手期辅助，宿主可感知身边十米内能量最浓郁之物一次。】“哦？还有这好事？”楚皓眼睛一亮，这系统还挺贴心。他立刻集中精神，依照系统的指引，将感知力缓缓散开。房间里的一切，桌椅板凳，被褥茶杯，都清晰地映入脑海。很快，他的注意力便被床头角落里一个不起眼的旧木盒吸引了。那里，正传来一股微弱，却异常精纯的能量波动。“咦？”楚皓有些意外。他伸手将那木盒取了过来。这是一个很普通的楠木盒子，边角已经有些磨损，看起来有些年头了。打开盒盖，里面静静地躺着一枚通体黝黑的玉佩。玉佩的样式古朴简单，没有任何花哨的纹路，表面也并非光滑如镜，反而带着一丝粗糙的质感，扔在大街上估计都没人会多看一眼。这枚玉佩，是原主母亲留下的唯一遗物。原主自小佩戴，后来身体日渐孱弱，才取下珍藏起来，却从未发现它有任何特异之处。楚皓拿起玉佩，入手微凉。他凝视着这枚黑玉佩，心中不由泛起一丝波澜。关于母亲的记忆已经很模糊了，只记得她总是带着温柔的笑容，轻轻抚摸他的头。“娘……”楚皓轻声呢喃，将玉佩紧紧握在掌心。他深吸一口气，再次运转《吞天魔功》。就在功法运转的刹那，掌心中的黑色玉佩突然微微一震，竟散发出一股温热的感觉！紧接着，一股奇异的吸力从玉佩中传出，与《吞天魔功》产生的吸力形成了强烈的共鸣！“嗡——”下一刻，楚皓只觉一股远比他自身元力精纯百倍，甚至千倍的磅礴能量，如同开闸的洪水一般，从黑色玉佩中狂涌而出！这股能量精纯至极，带着一丝古老而温润的气息，被《吞天魔功》疯狂地牵引着，通过他的手臂，涌入四肢百骸，冲刷着他的每一条经脉，每一个细胞！“好强的能量！”楚皓心中大骇，但更多的是狂喜！他体内的混沌圣体似乎也感受到了这股精纯的能量，自行运转起来，贪婪地吸收、炼化着这股突如其来的“大补之物”。那些原本坚固无比的修为瓶颈，在这股能量的冲击下，如同纸糊的一般，开始剧烈松动。

“轰！”楚皓只觉体内传来一声沉闷的巨响，仿佛有什么枷锁被彻底挣断！一股前所未有的强大力量感，充斥全身！淬体境四重！成了！那股舒畅淋漓的感觉，让他忍不住想仰天长啸！然而，这还没完！黑色玉佩中的能量依旧源源不断地涌出，似乎无穷无尽。楚皓不敢怠慢，全力运转《吞天魔功》和混沌圣体，疯狂地吸收炼化。他的气息，在以一种骇人听闻的速度节节攀升！淬体境四重中期！淬体境四重后期！淬体境四重巅峰！“轰！”又是一声闷响！瓶颈再次被摧枯拉朽般冲破！淬体境五重！楚皓浑身骨骼噼啪作响，皮肤表面渗出一层细密的黑色杂质，那是身体经过能量洗礼后排出的污垢。他能清晰地感觉到，自己的肉身强度、元力雄浑程度，都在发生着翻天覆地的变化！能量的灌输仍在继续！淬体境五重初期！淬体境五重中期！淬体境五重后期！直到……淬体境五重巅峰！当楚皓的气息稳稳停在淬体境五重巅峰时，那股从玉佩中涌出的能量才终于缓缓减弱，最终彻底消失。“呼——”楚皓长长地吐出一口浊气，这口浊气带着一丝淡淡的腥甜，仿佛将体内的所有郁结都吐了出去。他缓缓睁开双眼，眸中精光一闪而逝，如同暗夜中的星辰。感受着体内那澎湃汹涌，比之前强大了何止十倍的力量，楚皓嘴角忍不住勾起一抹自信的笑容。淬体境五重巅峰！仅仅片刻功夫，连破两重大境界，还直接冲到了五重巅峰！这《吞天魔功》和混沌圣体，配合这神秘玉佩，简直是逆天！“三个月后，青阳大比魁首？”楚皓握了握拳，感受着指掌间爆炸性的力量，眼中闪烁着强烈的战意，“呵呵，现在看来，似乎也不是什么难事了。”他摊开手掌，那枚黑色玉佩依旧静静地躺在那里，只是表面的光泽变得黯淡了许多，之前那股温热感也消失了，恢复了冰凉的触感，仿佛耗尽了所有能量。但楚皓知道，这枚母亲留下的玉佩，绝非凡物。今日只是初露峥嵘，日后定还有更大的秘密。他小心翼翼地将玉佩重新贴身戴好，感受着那份熟悉的冰凉，心中一片火热。萧清雪，林云，还有那些曾经看不起我楚皓的人，你们给我等着！三十年河西，莫欺少年穷！现在，轮到我楚皓，让你们好好看一看了！
